review.images: Checked seven native assets on the exact Dubai Creek Harbour project page, with a project tower view used for the card, a waterfront plaza hero and the apartment bedroom and living room separated from the children’s playroom.
review.location: Emaar map label includes the full Dubai Creek Harbour project name and provides the reference point. The branded one-page launch brief is hosted by Tanami Properties and corroborates the location and attractions. Neither provides numerical travel times for this building. RemApp’s file labelled brochure is byte-identical to the previously inspected one-page payment sheet and was not used for location.
review.floorPlans: Official 50-page floor plan pack matched the cached original. A broker-listed copy matched the same bytes and adds no separate sheets. Reviewed all 49 residence drawings and printed figures. Physical page 30 has a verified range, while townhouse pages 48 and 49 have two unit tables in reverse order in the raw text. Spatial review matched each table to the correct unit. All square-foot sums agree.

unavailable: Project-specific journey times, final building entrance and signed unit areas require confirmation.
